description: This source file defines the SettingsManager class responsible for loading, saving, and managing application settings, specifically handling the settings.xml file. It includes methods for retrieving current settings, loading default settings on failure, and saving new settings with progress updates.

classes.name: SettingsManager
classes.description: Provides static methods for accessing and persisting application settings, including loading from disk, handling defaults, and saving with progress indication.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Returns the current Settings object, loading it from disk if not already loaded.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Private method that attempts to load settings from a file, or provides default settings if the file is missing or corrupted.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overloaded method that saves the provided Settings object, optionally with progress display.
